# Laavin Infrascapes

> Landscaping, tree transplantation and irrigation company based in Delhi, working across Delhi NCR, North India and Central India. Led by a horticulturist with an M.Sc. in Botany and a civil and electrical engineer retired from the Delhi Development Authority (DDA).

## What we do
- Landscape design, building and maintenance: terrace, balcony and vertical gardens; hotel, office and farmhouse landscaping; sports grounds
- Mature tree transplantation (moving large trees instead of cutting them down)
- Drip and sprinkler irrigation, including systems that run on borewell or treated STP water
- Highway median and avenue planting, industrial green belts, and slope turfing
- Hardscaping: water features, paving, garden lighting, pergolas and shade structures

## Where we work
Based in New Ashok Nagar, Delhi. We work across Delhi NCR, North India and Central India, including Haryana, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh. For example, tree transplantation for Indian Railways in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh.

## Credentials
- Empanelled with NHAI, DDA and Indian Railways
- 75+ projects completed, 350+ trees transplanted, 10+ years of experience
- Work orders, completion certificates and client references available on request

## Selected projects
- NH-307: 155 mature roadside trees transplanted for NHAI (via Vasistha Construction Pvt. Ltd.)
- NH-7: 3,500 median plants for NHAI (via ATLAS Constructions (P) Ltd.)
- Ujjain: 80 trees transplanted for Indian Railways (via DRA)
- Delhi Airport Fuel Facility: green belt and landscaping
- Angels Public School, Faridabad: cricket ground and running track
- Gazipur landfill, Delhi: 2.5 acres of slope turfing (for UPL Environmental Engineers Ltd.)

## How we work
1. Site visit: soil test and a check of sunlight, water and drainage
2. Drawings, a plant list and an item-wise estimate
3. Building, planting and irrigation, with one project manager
4. Aftercare: regular maintenance, a photo report every month, and written terms for replacing plants that fail
We can work directly with the client or under a facility management (FM) company.
